entries.title: More babies to look after
entries.alt: Tray of healthy dwarf bean plants from the garden centre
entries.caption: Went to Ingham's, my favourite garden centre up the road, and picked up these dwarf beans, plus a couple of chillies and a kiwi plant. More babies to look after.
entries.why: This is me choosing something I genuinely enjoy and bringing more growing, nurturing and interest back into everyday life.
